options.systemMessage: Turn these weekly content operations metrics into a concise Telegram digest with totals, daily trend, channel output, delivery progress, and one practical recommendation. Use only supplied numbers.

parameters.content:
## Article intake and dedupe

Telegram links are normalized into stable content keys, then checked against Packs. Existing entries return their prior status and timestamp instead of creating duplicate work.

## Fetch and retry

Public article pages are fetched with one timed retry for temporary HTTP errors. Unreadable pages are logged in Errors and receive a clear Telegram response.

## AI pack and validation

gpt-6-luna generates structured copy, then a code gate checks JSON, required fields, and channel limits. One repair pass handles fixable failures before unpacking.

## Review queue and delivery

Every valid pack is stored for review with a schedule. The hourly queue sends only approved, due rows and writes delivered timestamps back to Sheets.

## Weekly digest

Sunday reporting combines pack and error rows, calculates output and operational metrics by day and channel, then sends an AI-written Telegram summary.

## Repurpose articles into review-ready social packs

### How it works
1. Send an article URL to Telegram. The workflow normalizes it, creates a stable content key, and checks whether it was already packaged.
2. It fetches the page, retries temporary HTTP failures once, then generates LinkedIn, X, newsletter, hook, and pull-quote copy with gpt-6-luna.
3. A quality gate validates JSON structure, required fields, and channel limits. Failed packs receive one repair pass.
4. Valid packs enter Google Sheets as pending_review with a schedule. Approved, due packs are delivered hourly, while Sunday metrics produce a Telegram digest.

### Setup steps
- [ ] Connect Telegram credentials to every trigger and message node.
- [ ] Connect OpenAI credentials to all three gpt-6-luna model nodes.
- [ ] Replace every spreadsheet placeholder and add the Packs and Errors headers listed in the template description.
- [ ] Replace the digest chat ID, then approve queue rows before their scheduled time.

### Customization
Adjust the copy limits, default schedule, review notes, digest timing, or replace Telegram delivery with your preferred publishing channel. Keep the content_key column to preserve deduplication across future workflow runs.
